info.description: Payment Sandbox simulation API (invoice, payment intent, refund, wallet).
info.title: Payment Sandbox API

get.description: Aggregates: total invoices, paid/failed/expired counts, total amount paid, total refund amount. Filterable by merchant and date range.
Backs the admin payment simulation panel: find intents to finalize, filtered by invoice and/or status.

patch.description: Transitions PENDING -> SUCCESS or FAILED. On SUCCESS, the invoice becomes PAID and wallet side-effects are applied atomically.

Single endpoint that drives the refund state machine via body action.
REQUESTED -> APPROVE/REJECT, APPROVED -> PROCESS (SUCCESS, debits merchant wallet) / FAIL.
Transitions PENDING -> SUCCESS or FAILED. On SUCCESS, credits the merchant wallet atomically.

post.description: Returns a short-lived access JWT and an opaque refresh token.
Revokes the supplied refresh token. Idempotent.
Rotates the refresh token: the supplied one is revoked, a new pair is returned.
Create a new merchant account. A wallet with zero balance is created automatically.

parameters.description: RFC3339 timestamp lower bound on created_at
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: RFC3339 timestamp upper bound on created_at
parameters.name: to

post.description: Authentication is optional. If a logged-in user submits with method=WALLET, the payer's wallet is debited on SUCCESS.

get.description: Lets the payer poll their payment status. The intent must belong to the invoice behind the token.

post.description: Available only when the invoice is PAID. Initial state: REQUESTED.
Creates a top-up record with status PENDING. An admin must process it to credit the wallet.
